hero.headline: Small-batch coffee, roasted every Tuesday.
hero.subheadline: Single-origin beans from farms we know by name, shipped within 48 hours of roasting.

content.intro_md: We started roasting in a garage in 2019 because we couldn't find coffee that tasted like the cups we'd had at origin. Five years on, the garage is bigger. The obsession isn't.

features.title: Direct trade
features.body_md: We pay farms 40% above Fair Trade minimum and visit every harvest.

features.title: Roasted to order
features.body_md: Nothing sits on a shelf. Your bag is roasted the week you order it.

features.title: Brew support
features.body_md: Every bag comes with a recipe card tuned to that roast.
